fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

min_standing_note.value: Must be a continuing degree-seeking undergraduate in good academic standing nominated by a partner university; attends St. Olaf as a non-degree-seeking J-1 exchange student.

eligible_majors.notes: Exact University-wide agreement scope (note 8 departments excluded by St. Olaf policy).

excluded_majors.notes: St. Olaf Smith Center explicitly bars incoming exchange students from registering in Computer Science, Economics, Education, Mathematics, Music, Nursing, Social Work, and Statistics.

min_gpa_host.notes: Good academic standing vetted by home institution; no numeric GPA cutoff published by St. Olaf for exchange partners.

english_course_availability.notes: US liberal arts college operating in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Standard international admissions benchmarks: TOEFL 90, Academic IELTS 6.5, or Duolingo English Test 120 (specific exchange partnership agreements may vary; verify partner waiver via Smith Center).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall Semester: Sep 10 - Dec 15, 2026 (new international students arrive Sep 1, 2026; optional January J-Term Jan 4 - Jan 29, 2027).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring Semester: Feb 10 - May 18, 2027 (note 4-1-4 calendar includes J-Term Jan 4 - 29, 2027).

tuition_model.notes: Smith Center site states incoming exchange students attend as non-degree students under their partner agreement, without publishing an explicit tuition-waiver quote on verified stolaf.edu pages (regular 2026-27 sticker tuition is $32,850/sem).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from St. Olaf AY 2026-2027 Student Accounts comprehensive fee schedule divided by 5 months: Multiple-occupancy housing $3,575/sem ($7,150/yr) + Meal Plan $3,925/sem ($7,850/yr) = $7,500/sem -> $1,500/mo. Excludes mandatory J-1 health insurance ($1,000/yr), $500 activities fee, books, and personal expenses.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly USD range 1,500/month. No FX conversion (1 USD = 1.0 USD; 5-month equivalent = 5 * 1,500.0 USD = 7,500.00 USD), calculated 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: J-1 exchange students are automatically enrolled (no waiver) in St. Olaf LewerMark J-1 health insurance at $1,000/yr (2026-27 billed in Fall/Spring installments), plus mandatory Minnesota immunizations (MMR & Td per St. Olaf DOCX).

housing_availability.notes: Residential college: full-time and incoming exchange students are required to live in college-owned housing (2026-27 billed rates posted at https://wp.stolaf.edu/stuacct/comprehensive-fee/).

housing_notes.value: 2026-27 billed rates: multiple-occupancy housing $3,575/sem ($7,150/yr) + meal plan $3,925/sem ($7,850/yr) per Student Accounts Comprehensive Fee schedule (see also https://wp.stolaf.edu/reslife/).

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No St. Olaf incoming exchange stipend verified.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Requires J-1 student visa (DS-2019 issued upon admission via Taylor Center/Smith Center), International Student Certification of Finances, English proficiency proof, mandatory J-1 health insurance, Minnesota immunizations, and potential 2-year home residency rule (212(e)) disclosure.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in https://www.stolaf.edu/catalog/ are taught in English; no separate English-only filter URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: 4-1-4 academic calendar system (Fall semester - January Term - Spring semester); exact numeric exchange credit limits unverified on stolaf.edu.

course_restrictions_note.value: Incoming exchange students cannot take courses in Computer Science, Economics, Education, Mathematics, Music, Nursing, Social Work, or Statistics.

value: International Student Certification of Finances form

academic_style.value: Residential 4-1-4 liberal arts college curriculum in Northfield, Minnesota.

city_tier.notes: Northfield, MN; official population figures in search results came from Wikipedia/nse.org (excluded).

campus_type.notes: 300-acre hilltop setting overlooking Cannon River Valley (~45 min south of Minneapolis-Saint Paul on stolaf.edu), without explicit rural/suburban enum confirmation.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated on stolaf.edu or DOCX (US English-speaking campus).

international_support_services.value: Smith Center for Global Engagement, Taylor Center for Equity & Inclusion (J-1/DS-2019 advising), Residential Life, and Student Health Service.

nomination_deadlines.notes: Coordinated directly with partner schools via the Smith Center (Nov 1 / Jan 15 dates on stolaf.edu are degree admissions; third-party StudioAbroad portal excluded).
